crossRefs.note: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let…
Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from…
But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases…
“Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,”…
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…
but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and…
So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.
If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”
Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband…

translations.web: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
translations.bsb: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
translations.kjv: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let ➔ not the wife depart from her husband:
translations.asv: But unto the married I give charge, yea not I, but the Lord, That the wife depart not from her husband
